description: Defines the MemoryPoolSlab class used for managing pinned byte buffer slabs within a memory pool, including creation, disposal, and active state management.

classes.name: MemoryPoolSlab
classes.description: A class representing a large memory slab divided into smaller blocks for a byte buffer memory pool, with management for pinned memory and lifecycle.

methods.name: MemoryPoolSlab
methods.description: Constructor that creates and pins a byte array as a memory slab.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new MemoryPoolSlab of specified length.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Method to unpin the memory slab and clean up resources.
